source: captured on rootless Podman 5.7.0 (runc, netavark, pasta): `podman pull --tls-verify=false` against a local stand-in registry that answers /v2/ with 200 and every manifest request with 403 (DENIED) or 401 (UNAUTHORIZED); registry address scrubbed
